title: Pure White Forest

allow.Sinful Spoils Subdual: Shared Sinful Spoils card: fetches Diabellze the White Witch, a Level 8 Illusion that is always treated as White Forest.
allow.Susurrus of the Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card: swaps a White Forest Spellcaster or Illusion for one in the GY, and sets itself again when a White Forest monster sends it as a cost.

summary: White Forest cards with generic staples, plus two shared Sinful Spoils cards; the Diabellstar and Azamina engines have their own lists. White Forest monsters pay their costs by sending a Spell/Trap to the GY, and the White Forest Spells and Traps set themselves again when they are sent that way, so the costs come back. Elzette of the White Forest summons itself and searches a White Forest monster, Silvy searches the Spells and Traps, and the Level 4 Tuners climb into the Synchro Tuners and Diabell, Queen of the White Forest. The 2025 cards lead. Witch of the White Forest searches a White Forest monster and can make one a Tuner. Poplar of the White Forest is a Level 4 Synchro Tuner that Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn. Diabellze the White Witch is always treated as a White Forest card. Witches of the White Forest is not out in the TCG yet.

exclude.Witches of the White Forest: Not yet released in the TCG.
